I’m also trying to keep my visitation steady. Ex is looking for any reason to say I’m not “stable.” One slip and I’m screwed.

Keep it real with me—what do guys actually do in that 6pm-to-bed window when the urge shows up? Stuff that works when you’re sore, tired, and you’ve still gotta be up before sunrise.
